@@U02354@@
One of us ended under the table, So keep your seat as long as you're able!

@@U02355@@
(Enter the GRACES.)

@@U02357@@
Into living we bring grace! In your giving give it place!

@@U02359@@
In receiving grace retain! Sweet it is a wish to gain.

@@U02361@@
And in days of thoughtful mood, Let grace sweeten gratitude.

@@U02363@@
Everyone! Please! To one side! What approaches now is not of your kind! Behold a mountainous beast, hung with rich, bright tapestries, two tusks in its head and a snakelike trunk. What a mystery! Ah, but I have it! I have the key! On his neck a delicate woman guides him with a slender staff. And on his back in a towering structure another one, glorious, exalted, whose dazzling radiance all but blinds me. Beside the beast are two women in chains; one of them fearful, the other glad; one of them hoping to be free, the other believing herself free. Let each now tell us who she is.

@@U02364@@
(Enter 佐伊洛斯忒耳西忒斯.)
translation:
@@U02354@@
我们中的一个人坐在桌子底下，所以请尽量保持座位！

@@U02355@@
（恩典上。）

@@U02357@@
我们将恩典带入生活！在你的奉献中给它一席之地！

@@U02359@@
在接受恩典中保留！甜蜜是一种获得的愿望。

@@U02361@@
在深思熟虑的日子里，让恩典让感恩变得甜蜜。

@@U02363@@
大家！请！到一侧！现在接近的不是你们的同类！看哪，这是一头山兽，身上挂着华丽、明亮的挂毯，头上长着两根獠牙，鼻子像蛇一样。多么神秘啊！啊，但是我有！我有钥匙！他脖子上挂着一位精致的女人，用一根细长的手杖引导着他。在他的背上，还有一座高耸的建筑，光荣而崇高，其耀眼的光芒几乎让我失明。野兽旁边有两个戴着铁链的女人。他们一个害怕，另一个高兴；其中一个希望获得自由，另一个则相信自己是自由的。现在让每个人都告诉我们她是谁。

@@U02364@@
（佐伊洛斯·忒耳西·忒斯上。）
